\begin{theorem}[Cylinder Cauchy--Sobolev realization]
For $S=-\alpha_g\int C^2$ with $\alpha_g>0$, the positive
branch residues are
\[R_E=R_L=4|\mathcal C_2|,\qquad R_A=2(A_A^2-4),\]
with Krein signs $(+,-,-)$.  Consequently the reduced Cauchy
spaces are
\[(H^1_{\rm TT}\oplus L^2_{\rm TT})_E\oplus
(H^{3/2}_{\rm T}\oplus H^{1/2}_{\rm T})_A\oplus
(H^1_{\rm TT}\oplus L^2_{\rm TT})_L.\]
The positive-frequency harmonic transform extends to a
Krein-unitary isomorphism onto the certified energy-mode
$E/A/L$ completion.
\end{theorem}
